title: moi project.yaml
description: Manifest that marks a directory as a moi project (a directory is a project iff it contains a project.yaml). Lives in the project's own directory; $MOI_HOME defaults to ~/Documents. Defines the standard core fields; tool-specific state lives under x-<tool>: namespaces.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier. A UUID is recommended; the literal 'home' is reserved for the root home project. Immutable.

slug.description: Optional stable, filesystem-safe identifier for cross-references (+slug task tags, tool URLs). Independent of the directory name. 'home' is reserved for the root home project.

type.description: Project kind. 'home' marks the single pinned personal project.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601). Unquoted YAML date scalars are equivalent; a YAML-aware validator stringifies them before applying this schema.

updated_at.description: Last-modified timestamp (ISO 8601). Unquoted YAML date scalars are equivalent; a YAML-aware validator stringifies them before applying this schema.

repos.description: Repositories/directories this project spans. Each entry is either a bare string (shorthand for a mapping with only path) or a repo mapping with a path, a web url, a clone remote, an optional branch, and optional per-repo actions and executables.

name.description: Human label; defaults to the last component of path or the remote's stem.

path.description: Where the repo's working tree lives. Absolute (or ~-prefixed) paths are the common case — code normally lives outside the moi tree; a relative path resolves against the project directory. Defaults to the repo name derived from remote.

url.description: Web URL of the repo — its browsable home page.

remote.description: Git remote to clone from (SSH or HTTPS). Absent means local-only; a tool may fall back to url when it is cloneable.

branch.description: Branch/ref to check out on clone.

actions.description: Named one-shot shell commands run in the repo's path. Conventional names: setup, build, test, lint, deploy, backup.

executables.description: Programs this repo can launch (long-running processes). Each entry is a single-key map from executable name to shell command, run in the repo's path.

^x-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Tool extension namespace. Owned by the named tool; arbitrary content. Other tools must preserve but not modify it.
